label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Country selector dialog and cookie banner both opened at once on arrival; the country dialog is in [name] while the rest of the page is [name], and focus started on the cookie region, so I had to hunt for the close controls.
Declining cookies needs a long settings dialog with a very long intro text read out before the toggles and the Confirm button; there is no simple Reject all button.

A dialog named only How It Compares (with just a Close button and no content) was reported open on the listing page, and the page title stayed Best Sellers even after I opened the product and later the bag.

Size options are announced as radios but cannot be jumped to directly; I had to Tab from Size Guide to reach them. Add to Bag stays disabled as Select a Size until a size is chosen, and nothing tells me which sizes are out of stock.

After Add to Bag, the checkout button and quantity controls were disabled for a moment with no clear loading message, and the checkout page first loaded as an empty page with only a heading before the form appeared.
